temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the community outreach project. When Maria offers help, Cheryl accepts and says it would be amazing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria suspected Cheryl was stressed or overloaded, but she had not confirmed whether Cheryl wanted or would accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl's reaction confirms that she is overwhelmed and welcomes Maria's assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl needs and is open to help; Maria can meaningfully assist her with the project.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and compassion, followed by willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and showing growing confidence. During a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, and Cheryl thanks Maria and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria knew Cheryl had been overwhelmed but had received help; she was not yet certain Cheryl was ready for a leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Seeing Cheryl's improved handling and confidence, and hearing her accept, leads Maria to believe Cheryl is capable and willing to lead.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is ready for the leadership role and appreciates Maria's confidence in her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl in leading the next phase of the project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl tells Maria she was a bit surprised by the leadership suggestion, but she appreciates Maria's support and says it means a lot that Maria believes in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worried that her public suggestion for Cheryl to lead might have made Cheryl feel overstepped or pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl's response shows she did not feel pressured; she felt supported and valued.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl values her support and that there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry or concern initially, then relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ensure Cheryl feels supported and maintain open, trusting communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl enthusiastically agrees to co-lead the project and says Maria's guidance has been invaluable and that they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria felt relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support; she believed continued collaboration could work but did not yet know if Cheryl wanted to co-lead.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl's eager acceptance confirms that she values Maria's guidance and wants an equal partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can effectively co-lead and support each other on the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees that their collaboration has been successful and their partnership strengthened. Cheryl says she would love to team up for more projects, calls working with Maria wonderful, and says she is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After several successful projects, Maria already believes their partnership is strong and synergistic; she hopes Cheryl wants to continue working together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl's enthusiastic response confirms she wants more collaboration and values their work together, reinforcing Maria's belief rather than changing it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong and has a promising future; they can achieve more together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl on more future projects.
